title: Bounded run constructing a window
statement: Let $ws$ be a Boolean word and $s\in\mathbb N$ such that its binary value is $s$, and let $d$ be a configuration in the specified entry state. Suppose tape $0$ stores $ws$ at every offset $p$ with $-1\le p\le |ws|$, tape $2$ is blank at those offsets, and tape $1$ is blank at every offset $p$ with $-1\le p\le 2s+1$. The constructed machine reaches its specified exit state at some time $t\le14(s+|ws|)+27$, never visits that exit state earlier, and up to time $t$ every work-tape head moves by at most $2s+|ws|+3$ from its initial position; at time $t$, tape $1$ contains the word of $s$ false bits, one true bit, and $s$ false bits on the interval of length $2s+1$ starting at its initial head position, and all other configuration components agree with $d$.
hypotheses_covered: Initial configuration $d$ has the specified entry state
Tape $2$ is blank at offsets $-1\le p\le |ws|$
Tape $1$ is blank at offsets $-1\le p\le 2s+1$
